Title: Global Knowledge Senior Data Analyst

Analyze large and diverse datasets to identify trends, patterns, gaps, root causes, and business opportunities. Translate complex data into actionable insights, business implications, and clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. Develop insight narratives and executive-ready summaries that support CX, commercial, product, and regional decision-making. Reporting, Dashboards & Performance Analytics Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical summaries that provide visibility into knowledge utilization, customer behavior, market needs, and platform performance. Track KPIs related to knowledge management, data products, adoption, data quality, and insight effectiveness. Monitor performance and recommend opportunities to increase accuracy, relevance, usability, automation, and business impact. Data Products & Value Creation Proactively identify opportunities to transform data and insights into scalable business solutions. Support the development of data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, diagnostics, and insight solutions. Partner with business, Product, CX, Commercial, and regional teams to assess customer value, business value, feasibility, scalability, and monetization potential. Help convert knowledge and data assets into solutions that create measurable customer, commercial, and operational value. Global Knowledge Base & Data Governance Support the consolidation, maintenance, enrichment, and expansion of Global Knowledge Base data. Help define and implement data standards, taxonomies, metadata structures, quality rules, and governance requirements. Monitor data quality and recommend improvements to data collection, modeling, and analytical processes. Strengthen consistency, accessibility, and usability of knowledge across regions and functions. AI, Automation & Advanced Analytics Support the application of AI, automation, semantic search, content intelligence, recommendation logic, and predictive analytics across the Global Knowledge ecosystem. Assist with testing and validating AI-enabled knowledge solutions, analytical models, and automated insight capabilities. Identify opportunities to use emerging technologies to improve knowledge discovery, relevance, and customer decision support. Partner with technology teams to continuously enhance the effectiveness of AI-enabled capabilities. Business & Technology Partnership Partner with IT/Digital and technology stakeholders to translate business needs into clear analytical, data, reporting, and platform requirements. Collaborate across CX, Commercial, Marketing, Product, and regional teams to understand business challenges and develop data-driven solutions. Communicate insights, opportunities, risks, and recommendations in a clear and business-oriented manner. Act as a translator between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on requirements and outcomes. Testing, Implementation & Continuous Improvement Support data publication, testing, validation, and business acceptance activities for data updates, dashboards, tools, and data products. Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production readiness activities for Global Knowledge solutions. Monitor solution adoption, usability, performance, and data quality after implementation. Recommend and support continuous improvements that enhance speed, accuracy, scalability, and business value. Business stakeholders receive clear, actionable insights that improve decision-making. Dashboards and analytical solutions provide meaningful visibility into customer, product, market, and knowledge performance. Data opportunities are successfully translated into scalable tools, products, and decision-support solutions. AI-enabled capabilities improve knowledge discovery, relevance, usability, and productivity. Data quality and governance continuously improve across the Global Knowledge ecosystem. Strong partnerships are established between business and technology teams. Knowledge and data solutions demonstrate measurable impact on customer experience, operational effectiveness, and business growth. Core Competencies Data analysis and analytical thinking. Business intelligence and data visualization. Data storytelling and executive communication. Business requirements gathering and translation. Problem-solving and root cause analysis. Data quality and governance. AI and digital technology awareness. Customer-centric thinking. Cross-functional collaboration. Stakeholder management and influence. Business and commercial acumen. Continuous improvement mindset. Project coordination and execution. Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business analysis, analytics, data management, digital platforms, or related functions. Experience collecting, cleaning, structuring, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources. Experience translating business needs into technical, data, analytical, or reporting requirements. Experience working with both technical and business stakeholders in cross-functional, matrixed environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects within a fast-paced, global environment. Hands-on experience with one or more data and analytics technologies such as SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, MongoDB, Alteryx, KNIME, Hadoop/Hive, Oracle, Power BI, Tableau, Python, or similar tools. Preferred Experience supporting data, analytics, Knowledge Management, Customer Experience, Business Intelligence, digital products, or related initiatives. Experience identifying business opportunities through data and translating them into dashboards, tools, product concepts, or decision-support solutions. Experience supporting small to medium-sized data projects from requirements gathering through implementation. Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, semantic search, recommendation engines, content intelligence, automation, or predictive analytics. Title: Analista Sr. POS (Point of sale)
Description: Grupo Ruz es una empresa mexicana con 35 años de experiencia en el desarrollo y distribución de productos con marcas reconocidas. A través de nuestras unidades de negocio Mobility y Toys, creamos productos innovadores que acompañan momentos importantes en la vida de nuestros consumidores, impulsados por el talento y la pasión de nuestros colaboradores. 1. Propósito del puesto. Convertir el sell-out, el inventario en cliente y el sell-in en conclusiones y acciones concretas para sus tres socios de negocio: Comercial, Sales Finance & Commercial Planning y Marketing. Cada análisis responde: ¿crecemos?, ¿qué lo explica?, ¿dónde está el riesgo? y ¿qué hacemos? No es un puesto de armar reportes: es de entender, concluir, recomendar y dar seguimiento hasta cerrar. 2. Responsabilidades Principales: • Análisis integral. Sell-out, inventario y sell-in en piezas y pesos vs. año anterior, por cliente, marca, licencia, categoría e ítem. • Desplazamiento por marca para Marketing. Identifica qué marcas y licencias impulsar y cuáles corregir, y lo entrega a Marketing como insumo de los planes de marca y del AOP. • Riesgo de inventario. Detecta marcas con caída y alto inventario en cliente, y alerta a Sales Finance & Commercial Planning sobre posibles notas de crédito. • Calidad del dato. Valida con KAMs y Team Leaders, cuadra totales y documenta la fecha de corte. • Presentación y seguimiento. Abre con hallazgos clave y cierra acuerdos con dueño y fecha con Comercial y Marketing. 3 3. Competencias Técnicas: • Sell-in, sell-out, inventario y cobertura; precio al público vs. sell-in y descuentos. • Explicar si la venta cambió por piezas, precio o mezcla, por cliente y por marca. • Saber que el bajo desplazamiento genera notas de crédito (no las calcula). • Leer el desempeño de cada marca contra el plan (AOP). • Portales de clientes, Walmart, Chedrahui, Soriana, Excel avanzado y PowerPoint ejecutivo. . Oracle FDI como usuario de reportes; . Inglés intermedio. • Proactividad: da seguimiento y avisa antes de un retraso. • Cercanía y empatía con Comercial, Finanzas y Marketing. • Comunicación asertiva, segura ante interlocutores senior. • Estructura y hands-on: valida sus datos antes de compartir. 4. Perfil de puesto Formación: Administración, Finanzas, Economía, Mercadotecnia, Ing. Industrial o afín, titulado Experiencia: 3 a 4 años en análisis comercial, POS, planeación, finanzas comerciales o trade marketing. Industria: juguetes, consumo masivo o retail (diferencial).

Title: Solutions Engineer
Description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. Role will be based in Mexico City, Mexico We are looking for a Solution Engineer who is accustomed to solving customer’s most complex problems and closing large deals. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value-based demonstrations, support enterprise Proof of Concepts, and ultimately help customers grow in their use of Snowflake. As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion about reinventing the AI Data platform space, thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop with technical audiences. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO: Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at Snowflake customers and prospects Work hands-on with customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology; identify use cases, and guide the customer to successfully take them from demo to implementation, and a successful go-live. Present Customers with the innovations in Snowflake and the value these innovations add to their business. Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them. Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing. ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE: Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos. Broad range of experience within large-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies Hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics Ability to understand a customer’s specific business problems and translate these to Snowflake use cases University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred Travel Required ABOUT OUR TEAM: Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? Title: Accounting Data Management – Aladdin Data -Vice President
Description: About This Role Your team The Accounting Data Management team is part of Aladdin Data and serves as a critical partner to BlackRock’s Investment Accounting and outsourced accounting business. The team manages the integrity, governance, and operational management of security, transaction, market, and accounting data used across investment accounting, regulatory reporting, portfolio operations, and client servicing. The team oversees the onboarding, validation, and maintenance of investment and accounting data while advancing automation, standardization, and scalable operating models. Through close partnership with accounting teams, portfolio operations, technology teams, data providers, and external investment managers, the team enables timely, accurate, and controlled data flows that support client reporting, regulatory obligations, and operational excellence. Your role and impact As the Accounting Data Lead, you will lead and develop a team supporting critical investment accounting data processes in Mexico. You will be responsible for strengthening data quality, operational controls, automation, and continuous improvement while helping the team deliver consistent and scalable outcomes. This role combines investment accounting knowledge, data management expertise, and people leadership. You will partner with global teams to improve processes, resolve complex data issues, enhance client outcomes, and advance BlackRock’s broader data strategy. Your Responsibilities In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Lead, develop, and mentor a team of data professionals, managing capacity, priorities, performance, and development while fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, inclusion, and operational excellence. Oversee the setup, maintenance, validation, and governance of security, transaction, market, and accounting data, ensuring its integrity, completeness, and accuracy across asset classes and data sources. Provide operational oversight of data pipelines, automated processes, exception management, and reconciliations, strengthening controls and issue-management practices to reduce operational risk. Partner with technology teams to improve data architecture, workflows, and straight-through-processing capabilities while identifying opportunities to automate, standardize, and simplify operational processes. Partner across Investment Accounting, Operations, Technology, Product, and Client Service to address complex data inquiries, identify root causes, and coordinate timely resolution across stakeholder groups. Support client onboarding, data migrations, and new implementations while building effective relationships with investment managers, custodians, market-data vendors, and other service providers. Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives focused on scalability, data quality, operating-model transformation, and platform modernization, using metrics and operational insights to improve efficiency, capacity planning, and service delivery. Your Experience Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Information Technology, Data Management, or a related field, with strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and communication capabilities. Eight or more years of relevant experience in investment operations, investment accounting, data management, or financial services, including experience leading teams or complex operational processes. Strong understanding of fixed income, equity, derivative, and alternative investments, with experience using accounting platforms, portfolio-management systems, or investment-operations workflows. Knowledge of investment accounting, fund accounting, regulatory reporting, or outsourced accounting operations, together with familiarity with data governance, data quality, risk management, and operational-control frameworks. Experience with Aladdin or comparable investment-management platforms, plus working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL), data analysis, automation, data-engineering concepts, and Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) processes. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity and change, influence stakeholders across functions and levels, and take ownership of high-quality outcomes. Experience leading process automation or operational-transformation initiatives, supported by a continuous-improvement mindset and a commitment to scalable solutions, innovation, collaboration, and client-service excellence. Our Benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law. BlackRock will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the requirements of the law, including any applicable fair chance law.
